_meta.description: Company-specific research inputs for Future Growth, Fundamental Quality and CAPEX

rules.futureGrowth: Score only from identifiable growth drivers, guidance, order book, market opportunity or capacity expansion
rules.fundamentalQuality: Score from profitability, balance-sheet quality, cash flow, ROCE/ROE and earnings consistency
rules.capexScore: Score from announced/ongoing capacity expansion, plant investment, order-backed expansion or major business investment
